title.en: Returning to Live in the Country (I)

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; the variant readings it marks are left out.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，删去其所注异文。

basis.en: Jin dynasty poem; the author died in 427.
basis.zh: 东晋诗，作者卒于 427 年。

note.en: Tao Yuanming gave up office in 405 and went home to farm; this is the first of five poems he wrote about it soon after. It is the founding poem of a long tradition, the scholar who chooses the field over the court. Notice how ordinary the furniture of happiness is: so many mu of land, so many rooms, a dog, a cock, some smoke over the village.
note.zh: 陶渊明 405 年辞官归田，不久写下这组五首诗，这是第一首。它开创了一个绵延很久的传统：读书人舍弃官场，选择田园。留意幸福的陈设有多平常：几亩地，几间屋，一声狗叫，一声鸡鸣，村子上空一缕炊烟。

excerpt.orig: 久在樊籠裏，復得返自然。
excerpt.en: Long I was kept inside a cage, / and now I have come back to what is natural.
excerpt.zh: 久在樊笼里，复得返自然。
